}

oe_chr.2 = {

# 3. First Centennial Retrospective (1437 — Age of Renaissance)
oe_chr.3 = {
	type = country_event
	title = oe_chr.3.title
	desc = oe_chr.3.desc
	outcome = positive
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_chr_imperial_annals.dds"
	trigger = { is_rebel_country = no }
	immediate = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = capital }
			capital = {
				add_timeline_note = {
					key = oe_chr_col_note_c1437
					location = this
					show_in_pop_graph = yes
					unique = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_chr.3.a
		ai_chance = { base = 100 }
		add_prestige = prestige_mild_bonus
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_chr_col_century_glory_mod years = 10 mode = replace }
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_chr.3.b
		ai_chance = { base = 0 }
		add_prestige = prestige_weak_bonus
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_chr.1
	}
}

oe_chr.9 = {

					key = oe_chr_col_note_1836_apotheosis
					location = this

				}
			}
		}

		name = oe_chr.9.a
		ai_chance = { base = 100 }
		if = {
			limit = { oe_chr_col_milestone_count >= 15 }

		else_if = {
			limit = { oe_chr_col_milestone_count >= 11 }

		else_if = {
			limit = { oe_chr_col_milestone_count >= 7 }
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_chr_col_grade_b_mod years = 50 mode = replace }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { oe_chr_col_milestone_count >= 4 }
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_chr_col_grade_c_mod years = 50 mode = replace }
